question: Should maintainers accept this generated batch after representative multilingual sampling and completion of the remaining checks on the current head?
rationale: The generator and CI establish structural correctness, but they cannot determine whether all machine-generated user-facing translations are fluent and semantically appropriate.

options.title: Sample and merge
options.body: Sample representative new and changed strings across several scripts/locales, then merge if the remaining exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Regenerate after corrections
options.body: Pause the PR and correct the English source, glossary, or generator inputs before rerunning the controlled refresh if sampling finds material translation errors.

recommendation.title: Sample and merge
recommendation.body: Sample representative new and changed strings across several scripts/locales, then merge if the remaining exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor introduced the generator-backed locale refresh pipeline that owns the proposed output.
